public_definitions: Use the cross-border public statistics dashboard as the evidence source for deciding which 2012 country indicator value is larger.

Review the public cross-border statistics dashboard, compare the 2012 reported indicator value for United States and Canada, then open the country indicator follow-up record for the country with the larger 2012 value.
